what: Step 7 resolves `RESOLVED_ROOT` with prepare-time `CURRENT_VERSION` before installed metadata and `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT`
scenario_or_breakage: `CURRENT_VERSION` is the Step 2 prepare KV (pre-bump main semver per `.claude/skills/release/scripts/release-prepare.md:21`), not necessarily the running install. If `$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/${CURRENT_VERSION}` exists while Claude is on another cached version, `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` targets the wrong tree; `upgrade-larch.sh` prune protects `basename "$PLUGIN_ROOT"` (`upgrade-larch.sh:255-265`) and can delete the live cache dir
suggested_fix: Reorder resolution: parse installed version / validate session `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` first; use prepare `CURRENT_VERSION` only when it matches installed metadata or drop it; reuse `get_installed_larch_version` logic from `upgrade-larch.sh:113-139`
